Messages.Author: Hardy
Messages.Body:
If I bleed my prey for 1 can I play Major Boon to take the bleed and
defer a bigger bleed to him later?

Messages.Author: GreySeer
Messages.Body:
"Hardy" <hjoh...@shell.com> wrote in message
news:912db102.01100...@posting.google.com...

> If I bleed my prey for 1 can I play Major Boon to take the bleed and
> defer a bigger bleed to him later?

No.

From the online rulings and errata:

"Any player (not just "you") can modify the bleed after the Boon, subject to
the normal rules. Major Boon cannot be played by the controller of the
acting minion." [RTR 19980707]

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Hardy wrote:
>
> If I bleed my prey for 1 can I play Major Boon to take the bleed and
> defer a bigger bleed to him later?

No. You cannot play Major Boon if you control the acting minion.
(And you cannot play out-of-turn masters on your own turn, anyhow).

Well, if you bleed with a Malkavian with a Madness Network in play this gets
around the "your turn" part (but not the control of the acting minion).

BTW: Speaking of Madness Network, "After another Methuselah has finished all of
his or her minion phase actions, any untapped Malkavian can take an action (go
clockwise if two or more attempt to take actions)." So this occurs after a
Methusaleh's minion phase actions but is it still during that Methusaleh's
minion phase? If Methusaleh A has finished his/her actions, and Methusaleh B's
Malkavian decides to act, what happens if A wants to burn Temptation counters
to take control of the acting vampire during the action? Thanks!

Halcyan 2

I have a fond memory of this card. I played it on my
grand-predator early in a six-player game. Later, my predator was
ousted. When grannie came after me, it was late in the game. She had
forgotten about the Major Boon. She tried to bleed me, I let it
through, she pumped up the bleed, and then I told her to pay for it
and that ousted her. I didn't get the six for ousting her, but it was
funny.

Sincerely,

Gene Wirchenko
